protocol.replay: 10 causal decisions, each sees newly arrived logged BEV; 1.0 s total
protocol.next: First action at the anchor; 0.1 s
protocol.fixed5: Anchor memory only, zero prefix, reset decoder hidden, five calls; 0.5 s
protocol.aggregation: Unique (recording,timestamp) anchors; all original event labels retained
protocol.manifest_window_weighted: Duplicated label windows counted as in training validation
protocol.historical_loss: Original beta=1 SmoothL1 action formula, separate from current L1
protocol.missing: Excluded, never zero; FDE requires complete horizon
protocol.constant_action: Repeat the last historical local action; no future state inputs
protocol.statistical_inference: Descriptive paired comparison, no independent-log CI
